note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere (owner in comment). Convertible to skill-creator's eval format; run via its description-tuning loop or manual fresh-session baseline.
